title: setup: the AI Approvals nav entry is gated by manage_platform_settings, so a builder whose MCP proposal waits there reaches it only by URL (cloud#3685 review)
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Filing gate: **(c) should-fix carried from a contract review** (objectstack-ai/cloud#3685, review 6692522928). The MCP build door's staged removals are approved by their proposer on the console's AI Approvals page.

## 维护者速读

通过 MCP 发起的「清理示例数据」要本人在「AI 审批」页面批准，但 Setup 里这个页面的入口只有有平台设置权限的人才看得到。一个只有搭建权限的人，只能靠 MCP 返回的网址才能找到它。需要让能发起待办的人在导航里也看得到自己的审批入口。

## Readings

- Framework `platform-objects` `setup.app.ts`: `group_approvals` is gated by `manage_platform_settings`.
- The page itself serves proposer-only actions, so a builder with `manage_metadata` can open it by URL (`/_console/apps/setup/system/ai-approvals`).

## Expected

- The nav entry is visible to anyone who can have a pending action, i.e. who can propose one. The lane names the right grant, or splits "my approvals" from the admin view. ⛔ It must not widen what the page lets them approve.

## Acceptance

- A builder without `manage_platform_settings` sees the entry and only their own proposals; an admin view stays gated.

Suggested-grade: p2.
